name: Multiple bills due with low balance - confirmation required
description: User has electricity, internet, phone bills due but spent on a $500 concert tickets last week. Balance is $1,200. Decision point: can they cover bills?
user_request: My bills total $405 but I spent $500 on concert tickets and now only have $1,200. Should I transfer from stash or use my credit card?
expected_reasoning_path: Calculate exact bill total: electricity $180 + internet $85 + phone $95 + streaming $45 = $405
Check if bills can be paid directly from spending balance: YES, $1200 > $405
Point out: Concert ticket purchase already happened - the real question is about upcoming obligations
Connect to conscious spending: 'You spent $500 on joy. Now you need to find $405 for obligations. Where do you find it?'
Offer automation: Set up automatic transfers for bills to avoid this situation
Suggest: Create separate 'obligations' bucket or use automatic bill pay
expected_final_outcome: Analysis showing bills CAN be paid from current balance, no transfer needed, but automation suggested to prevent future shortfalls

forbidden_behaviors.detection_pattern: use your credit card|pay with card|card payment
